items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: so they got together a tour between Helen Peterson and Will Rogers, Jr., and Bob Bennett who was the Commissioner of Indian Affairs.

ctx.x: taught school before in Wisconsin. She had taught high school. She was in charge of producing plays, and I said, if you want to do that, I won't stand in your way because I can understand. When I go away on my tours . . . (End of Side 1)

So she went back to school, she went back to teaching and I had the opportunity to at one time, I was going to Washington, we go to Washington together, and I played at Blues Alley and then knowing we belong to the National Conference of Indians in Washington, we knew Helen Peterson who was the publicity director, and so they got together a tour between Helen Peterson and Will Rogers, Jr., and Bob Bennett who was the Commissioner of Indian Affairs. They cooked up a tour where I could get a group from New York,…
